verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing's API and docs clearly support core operations an agent would need — creating/updating cards and balance accounts (docs-1, docs-10, docs-11, docs-15), reading transactions/card payments (docs-13), and adjusting spend controls via transaction rules and dynamic limits (docs-3, docs-18, docs-22). However there is no evidence of an MCP server/surface, no mention of scoped API-key credentials tailored for autonomous agent use, and the OpenAPI/spec probe returned 404s, suggesting no discoverable machine-readable API schema for agent tooling. missing for 10: MCP surface or agent-specific integration, explicit scoped-credential/API-key model for agents, discoverable OpenAPI spec.
